['Helm AG '].company_description: Helm AG is a European multinational pharmaceutical and biotechnology company headquartered in Budapest. It is the largest pharmaceutical company in Central and Eastern Europe, with an expanding direct presence in Western Europe, China, Northern America, and Latin America. Helm AG has the largest R&D unit in Central and Eastern Europe and operations in over 100 countries. The company sells products for the central nervous system, women’s health, and cardiovascular therapeutic areas among others. Helm AG is also active in biosimilar product development.

['John Deere GmbH & Co. KG '].company_description: John Deere GmbH & Co. KG, founded in 1837, develops and delivers innovative products for agriculture. It operates more than 70 manufacturing facilities in 19 countries and sells its products in 160 countries worldwide. With nearly 19,000 employees, it is the largest employer in Europe. The company has a strong presence in Europe, CIS, Africa, and the Near & Middle East.
